shared_elements: tall upright rectangular slab bearing low relief on its broad face
relief imagery organized into stacked horizontal zones/registers
horizontal band of repeated small motifs
schematic figural forms rendered in shallow raised relief
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic format of a tall upright carved slab whose broad face carries shallow relief divided into stacked zones, including a horizontal band of repeated small elements. What is actually depicted differs entirely: B shows profile animals (a snarling quadruped, birds/long-necked creatures) and rows of abstract arch- and H-like signs, while A's face carries an apparently frontal standing human figure with a vertical column of small square signs beside it, and no animals in profile are shared.
